# Independent Code Review
Read the actual diff and surrounding source; do not edit. Trace frontend/GAS contracts and Test Mode boundaries. Prioritize exploitable security, data loss, broken state transitions, offline regressions, and protected QR changes. Label severity and evidence. Separate review from test execution.
